title: Exercise After a Mommy Makeover: Week-by-Week Workout Plan
meta_description: Walk from day one, wait about 6 weeks for strenuous exercise, get clearance before core work: a sourced week-by-week workout plan after a mommy makeover.
excerpt: Walking starts on the day of surgery, strenuous exercise usually waits about six weeks, and abdominal work over a muscle repair waits for your surgeon. Here is a week-by-week plan, what changes after breast surgery, how to get fit first, and the signs you are doing too much.
quick_answer:
When can I exercise after a mommy makeover?

Walk from the day of surgery to keep blood moving. The Aesthetic Society says you will probably need to wait 6 weeks before strenuous activities, and Cleveland Clinic says heavy lifting usually waits 4 to 8 weeks after a tummy tuck. Exercises that work a repaired abdominal muscle start only when your surgeon clears them.

sources.title: Mommy makeover: aftercare and recovery
quotes: You will probably need to wait six weeks after surgery before attempting any strenuous activities.
you still shouldn't do any heavy lifting (such as picking up your children or baskets of laundry) for four to six weeks.
If you have small children, you must put someone else totally in charge of their care for at least two weeks.
You may be up and walking within hours of surgery

Call your surgeon immediately if you notice an increase in swelling, pain, redness, drainage, or bleeding in the surgical area
Other red flags include shortness of breath, chest pains, and unusual heartbeat.
